text:
maria: quick heads-up — sales flagged Gatekeeper (predictive routing) as a Q2 ask from 3 enterprise pilots. they want throughput guarantees + smarter fallback sequencing. can we re-run RICE and decide scope?

sam: is this the same ask that increased token throughput last quarter? iirc customers asked for per-route fallback not model-level only. :thinking:

elaine: correct — it's narrower: route-level prediction + affinity cache. customers: Acme, Meridian, BrightBank. they claim 10–20% cost reduction if we avoid cold starts.

tom: effort estimate from infra: full end-to-end (prediction model + control plane + telemetry) ~12w (2 SWEs, 1 infra). if we split into MVP (prediction + simple routing) + phase2 (control plane + optimizations) MVP could be 5–6w.

ash: +1 to split. we should score MVP separately. the big unknown is confidence on impact and ops cost.

jordan: i ran a quick RICE for MVP hypothesis: Reach = 30 pilot customers (est), Impact = 7 (moderate product win), Confidence = 0.55, Effort = 1.5 (in quarter units). RICE = (30 * 7 * 0.55) / 1.5 = 77

sam: wait math check — you're using effort in quarter units (1.5 means ~6w?) we should be consistent with other items in board. most items use effort = dev-weeks/4.

jordan: right — let me restate with weeks: Reach=30, Impact=7, Confidence=55%, Effort=6w -> effort in quarters = 6/12 = 0.5 (we've been using 12w quarter baseline). RICE=(30*7*0.55)/0.5 = 231

elaine: that looks high. i think reach is overstated — only 3 pilots will adopt initially, then N months for broader GA. maybe Reach=8 in quarter.

maria: sales argued ~30 accounts would trial within 1 quarter given current pipeline. can we compromise: Reach=12 for MVP (pilots + warm customers), Impact=8 for cost/latency win, Confidence=0.6, Effort=6w -> RICE=(12*8*0.6)/0.5 = 115.2

sam: main product concern: sequencing risk. if we build MVP that doesn't integrate with rollout hooks in Console, we'll block adoption. need a minimal rollout gate (canary + kill switch). adding that adds ~1w.

ash: proposal: scope MVP to prediction + routing lib + console toggle for canary (adds 1w). Phase2 adds affinity cache and autoscale tuning. That makes Effort=7w -> effort quarters = 7/12 ~0.583. Recalc RICE=(12*8*0.6)/0.583 = ~98.

tom: we also need launch criteria nailed. suggested alpha acceptance criteria: 1) p95 additional routing latency < 40ms (on top of baseline), 2) fallbacks reduce cold-starts by >50% for pilot flows, 3) no >2 incidents in 2 weeks.

jordan: can we add a measurable quality/regression guard? tie to prompt-set evals and a small set of telemetry-driven checks. if quality drops >5% we block rollout.

maria: agreed. action items: 1) jordan to update RICE sheet with Reach=12/Conf=60/Impact=8/Effort=7w by EOD, 2) tom to draft alpha acceptance criteria and canary plan, 3) ash to write initial scope split doc (MVP vs phase2).

sam: +1. if we land RICE >90 for MVP we'll move it into candidate list for next sprint planning. :thumbsup:

prio-bot: reminder — please attach RICE sheet link and owner to the ticket.

elaine: linking the sales notes + customer quotes in the ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-842 (private)

maria: perfect — let's reconvene in async thread on Wed for final score. thanks everyone. :rocket:
